g.text: Black points: unchanged full estimate in every panel
Compare original uncertainty with observed sensitivity: single-component and single-donor omission ranges remain negative.
Only panel A shows a 95% bootstrap interval; panels B/C show influence ranges, not confidence intervals.
The external original interval spans zero. Omission stability does not establish significance, causality or independent replication.
